dispute_ticket.description: The meter finished at $21.10 but the app estimated $17.50. The driver went a long way round and did not warn me before turning off. I was late for my appointment. I want the $3.60 difference refunded.

trip_data.driver_reported_reason: Road closed ahead on the planned route; went around it

chat_logs.content: Sorry boss, lane closed at Tampines Ave 10 flyover, I have to go around via the service road.
Why so long?? I have an appointment at 11. Just hurry.
Fare is way above the estimate.

app_events.details: Rider R-7101 booked a RydeTAXI (metered) trip RYDE-DS-001. Metered fare estimate S$17.50 (9.0 km, 18 min).
Driver D-8101 (Tan Kok Wee, Toyota Prius SKB 4417 K) assigned.
LTA road works alert active 10:00-14:00: Tampines Ave 10 flyover, eastbound lane closed. Planned route intersects the closure.
Trip completed. Distance 11.0 km, 24 min. Route consistent with a diversion around the closure.
Metered fare S$21.10 (flag-down S$4.00 + 11.0 km x S$0.90 + 24 min x S$0.30) charged to credit card.
Receipt screen showed 'payment pending' for about 3 minutes after drop-off, then updated to the final fare.

refund_at_ryde_discretion.text: Governs refunds on this trip. A true value means Ryde may refund beyond the strict rules where the facts justify it. It does not create a right to a refund.

fare_basis.value: metered: flag-down S$4.00 + S$0.90 per km + S$0.30 per minute
fare_basis.text: States how this trip's fare is set: a fixed upfront price, or a metered fare that varies with distance and time.

detour_for_verified_road_closure_billabl.text: Governs extra distance caused by a road closure. A true value means the rider may be billed for it only when the closure is verified.

expected_outcome.reason: RydeTAXI is metered, so the S$17.50 figure is an estimate, not a fixed fare. The app log shows an active LTA alert for a lane closure at Tampines Ave 10 flyover at 10:36:40, the driver's chat at 10:37 names the same closure, and the GPS shows the diversion. Under this trip's policy a detour for a verified road closure is billable, and the extra S$3.60 is exactly 2.0 km x S$0.90 plus 6 min x S$0.30 on the meter rates. The driver not warning earlier, the rider's hurry and the short receipt glitch do not change that.
